name: Swemo MCP — Riksbank
author: aerugo
description: Queries Riksbank monetary-policy forecasts and series for inflation, GDP, unemployment and the policy rate. Local stdio integration with dated setup documentation.

quality.reason: Source review only; no runtime test or full rubric assessment. Python 3.12+ and stdio are supported in the inspected source; no API key is configured. Source activity dates to April 2025 and README local examples incorrectly reference kolada-mcp. SWEA/SWESTR and HTTP/SSE claims are not established by the registered monetary-policy tools.
